questions.prompt: A model has a window of 1,000,000 tokens and pi uses reserveTokens 16384. At which context size does pi start to compact?
questions.explanation: The trigger is contextTokens above the window minus the reserve: 1,000,000 - 16,384 = 983,616.

questions.prompt: After a compaction, what is true of the session file?
options: The older entries are deleted to save space
The older entries are moved to a second file
The older entries are rewritten as the summary
Nothing is deleted; a compaction entry is added
questions.explanation: The summary is saved as a compaction entry. The old entries stay in the file, and only what the model sees changes.

questions.prompt: Why does pi never cut at a tool result?
options: Tool results are too large to summarise
A tool call and its result must stay together
Tool results are not saved in the log
The summary must start with a tool result
questions.explanation: If the cut fell between a call and its result, the kept part could hold a result with no call, or a call with no result.
